questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: A particle moves along a circular track of radius R and completes exactly half a revolution. The ratio of the distance travelled to the magnitude of its displacement is:
questions.explanation: Distance = half the circumference = πR. Displacement = diameter = 2R. Ratio = πR/2R = π/2.
questions.ncertReference: Physics Class 11, Chapter 3: Motion in a Plane

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: Newton's second law states that the net external force acting on a body is equal to its:
options: Rate of change of linear momentum
Rate of change of kinetic energy
questions.explanation: F = dp/dt. For a body of constant mass this reduces to the familiar form F = ma.
questions.ncertReference: Physics Class 11, Chapter 4: Laws of Motion

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: A uniform metallic wire of resistance R is stretched so that its length becomes twice the original. If the volume stays constant, the new resistance is:
questions.explanation: R = ρl/A. Doubling the length halves the area (volume constant), so R' = ρ(2l)/(A/2) = 4R.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: The number of molecules present in 22.4 L of an ideal gas at STP is:
questions.explanation: At STP the molar volume of any ideal gas is 22.4 L, which corresponds to 1 mole, i.e. 6.022 × 10²³ molecules.
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 11, Chapter 1: Some Basic Concepts of Chemistry

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: The maximum number of electrons that can be accommodated in a subshell with azimuthal quantum number l = 2 is:
questions.explanation: A subshell can hold 2(2l + 1) electrons. For l = 2 (the d-subshell) this gives 2(5) = 10.
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 11, Chapter 2: Structure of Atom

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.topic: Organic Chemistry: Some Basic Principles and Techniques
questions.question: Which of the following carbocations is the most stable?
questions.explanation: Alkyl groups release electron density by the +I effect and hyperconjugation, so stability follows 3° > 2° > 1° > methyl.
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 11, Chapter 8: Organic Chemistry: Some Basic Principles and Techniques

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: Which cell organelle is non-membrane bound and acts as the site of protein synthesis?
questions.explanation: Ribosomes are made of rRNA and proteins and possess no membrane. They are 70S in prokaryotes and 80S in eukaryotes.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 8: Cell: The Unit of Life

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: In C₄ plants, the primary CO₂ acceptor present in mesophyll cells is:
questions.explanation: In the C₄ (Hatch and Slack) pathway, PEP in mesophyll cells accepts CO₂ using PEP carboxylase to form the 4-carbon acid OAA.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 11: Photosynthesis in Higher Plants

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: The volume of air inspired or expired during a normal respiration is called:
questions.explanation: Tidal volume is roughly 500 mL of air moved in or out in each quiet breath.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 14: Breathing and Exchange of Gases

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: The pacemaker of the human heart is:
questions.explanation: The SA node lies in the right atrium and generates the fastest impulses (about 70-75 per minute), so it sets the cardiac rhythm.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 15: Body Fluids and Circulation
